top_signals.title: How Russia Sees the World Now
top_signals.summary: Dmitry Adamsky, an expert on Russian security and Russian nuclear deterrence strategy at Harvard and Reichman Universities, examines a large-scale shift in Russia’s strategic thinking over the past year, centered around the view that Europe, rather than the United States, is now Russia’s primary geopolitical rival and adversary, and looking at the consequences of this shift for US efforts to end the war in Ukraine.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China Stocks Set for Bear Market as AI Trade, Policy Hopes Fade
top_signals.summary: China’s mainland-listed shares are on track to enter a technical bear market as waning hopes for substantial stimulus, lackluster earnings and lingering jitters over the global artificial intelligence trade weigh on sentiment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: France’s borrowing costs hit 5% for first time since 2002
top_signals.summary: Concerns over public finances and political stability have helped push up 10-year bond yields from 3.2% in late February
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Indonesian Stocks Rebound as Sovereign Wealth Fund Shows Support
top_signals.summary: Indonesian shares rebounded from earlier losses, as the nation’s sovereign wealth fund said it has been buying local stocks.
